metadata.purpose: Enumerate, track, and resolve ontological issues identified in PR #26 cross-platform determinism work

issues.title: Windows CI runner line-ending mismatch
issues.description: Python scripts checked out on Windows received CRLF line endings, causing hash mismatches vs UTF-8 LF on Linux/macOS.
issues.resolution_notes: PR #27 added .gitattributes with text=auto eol=lf for all Python/YAML/JSON files; CI now normalises line endings at checkout.

issues.title: Missing PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 on Windows
issues.description: Windows CI runners default to cp1252 stdout encoding, breaking any code that writes UTF-8 characters to stdout/stderr.
issues.resolution_notes: PR #27 and PR #28 CI YAML set env PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 at workflow level for all jobs.

issues.title: Integer arithmetic endianness sensitivity
issues.description: Weight generation code used platform-native integer arithmetic. On big-endian or 32-bit platforms the output differed.
issues.resolution_notes: Determinism test (test_cross_platform_determinism.py) uses bitwise two's-complement int64 arithmetic (platform-independent). Merkle root verified identical across Ubuntu, macOS, Windows.

issues.title: Filesystem path separator differences
issues.description: Hard-coded forward-slash paths failed on Windows where os.sep is backslash.
issues.resolution_notes: All path construction now uses pathlib.Path, which is cross-platform.

issues.title: safetensors int64 incompatibility
issues.description: safetensors >= 0.4 changed int64 handling, causing CI failures on older pinned versions.
issues.resolution_notes: PR #27 pinned safetensors to a compatible version and added pip install --upgrade to ensure correct resolution.

issues.title: Python version matrix not exhaustive
issues.description: CI only tested Python 3.11; 3.12 behavioural differences (e.g. hash randomisation seed) were untested.
issues.resolution_notes: PR #28 CI matrix includes python-version: ['3.11', '3.12'] across all three OS runners.

issues.title: Merkle root not compared cross-platform
issues.description: Previous CI computed a Merkle root on Linux only; no cross-OS comparison was performed.
issues.resolution_notes: PR #28 CI uploads the Merkle root from each OS as an artifact; the compare-merkle-roots job downloads all six (3 OS × 2 Python versions) and asserts equality, failing the build on any mismatch.

issues.title: No falsification test for seed_bytes assumption
issues.description: The spec assumed seed_bytes is interpreted identically on all platforms, but this was never tested.
issues.resolution_notes: test_falsification.py validates: seed_bytes round-trips through hashlib.sha256 identically, int64 two's-complement arithmetic matches expected vectors, UTF-8 encoding of output is preserved, pathlib paths resolve consistently.

issues.title: No strategic knowledge document for future contributors
issues.description: All environmental assumptions and tactical lessons were buried in PR history and chat logs, making them invisible to future AI/human contributors.
issues.resolution_notes: docs/ORTHOGONAL_ENGINEERING_COMPENDIUM.md created in PR #28. All environmental assumptions, tactical fixes, and verification procedures are documented there.
